descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8 · “A phone with a wrong clock, no clock set, or a different time zone shows the same state”. Mixed: stated part — wrong or unset phone clock shows the same badge and Note Format pre-selection as the web; our part — native picker, background and reopen, camera scan on a real device (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B18 · S1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10). Re-test 2026-10-16 (TC-21/S26, 25acd727): a browser two days ahead writes the badge roll with its own future day (encTypeDay 2026-10-19) to the shared record, so the correct-clock browser shows Follow-up too. Re-test 2026-10-20 on 8b4be94a: changed: task done time and Important Points now use server time (TC-22/S23, TC-12/S23, TC-07/S28 stamp); still device time: Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary edit (TC-17/S25), task screen header date (TC-07/S28), handoff title date (TC-08/S20), medicationsUpdatedAt (TC-19/S19), NEW TODAY (TC-01/S08), completeEncounter day (OAT-06/S10).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-21/S22, TC-25/S24b, TC-19/S23, TC-21/S26, TC-17/S25, TC-07/S28, TC-08/S20

Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S23 Native iOS/Android on the local stack: tap the badge, change it, background and reopen; camera scan lands Follow-up; a phone with a wrong date or no clock set shows the same badge

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U2 Every scanned patient defaults to Follow-up (Hospital census-photo scan and Nursing Home resident-list scan) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2)
  • U6 The day roll uses server time, not the device clock: a device with a wrong date, no clock set or another time zone shows the same badge and the same pre-selected template as any other device, and nev … (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8)
  • U12 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (step 7, ground rule 3.3) (UAT TC-06; UAT 3.3; TFA-92584 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Android: the debug build of main e02167f bundled for the local stack (scripts/android-lane.ts: adb reverse tcp:4510/4511 on AVD rc_api36, or a USB phone with the same reverse). iOS: a local Xcode build of main pointed at the local stack. Second device: the web app on Vite 6473. …

When Tap the chart badge and pick each state in the native picker, background the app and reopen; photograph a printed census and a resident list; then set the phone's date one day back and set a patient and a resident to New Admission on the phone; …

Then The native picker offers the three states; the choice persists after reopening; every scanned patient is Follow-up; with the phone's clock wrong or unset, the phone and the web device show the same badge and Note Format pre-selection, and what the phone set still reads New Admission on the web device

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same as the S01/S02/S05 checkpoints, judged by a person. UAT 3.8 'Test with one device set to the wrong date' + TFA-92584 AC 8: on main the phone's day decides, so the clock cells are expected to Fail (known: TFA-92584 AC 8). 3.9: record the vision model

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
